description: Confirm-gated credentials GET path. The instance_id rejections carry confirm=true because the gate is asked before the arguments are read: a caller who has not confirmed learns nothing about whether their arguments would have been accepted, which for a read whose whole answer is a secret is the point of the gate. The numeric and boolean bodies are the non-object shapes both languages reject rather than reporting blank credentials as a success; other non-object shapes still diverge and are tracked in the report, so do not assume this list is the whole malformed-body surface.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This retrieves Managed Database credentials. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects missing instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects zero instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: dry run reads the instance without retrieving the secret

side_effects: PostgreSQL Managed Database credentials will be retrieved and exposed.
warnings: The response contains sensitive password material.

cases.name: rejects a numeric API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to retrieve PostgreSQL Managed Database credentials

cases.name: rejects a boolean API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to retrieve PostgreSQL Managed Database credentials
